Boulder collapse at Bengaluru quarry kills at least seven workers

A large boulder collapsed at a stone quarry on the outskirts of Bengaluru, killing at least seven workers and injuring five. The incident occurred in the Madappanahalli area when a rock fell on labourers working at the site. While initial reports stated seven deaths, some outlets reported nine fatalities, with victims identified as originating from Bihar and Assam. Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar stated that quarries flouting norms would face action, and a probe is underway.
